sanskrit: agnir bhūtvā naigameyaś chāgavaktro bahuprajaḥ ramayām āsa śailasthaṃ bālaṃ krīḍanakair iva
english: Agni, having become Naigameya, the goat-faced one with many offspring, entertained the child dwelling on the mountain as if with playthings.

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca grahāḥ sopagrahāś caiva ṛṣayo mātaras tathā hutāśanamukhāś cāpi dīptāḥ pāriṣadāṃ gaṇāḥ
english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: The planets along with their sub-planets, the sages and the mothers, and also the blazing hosts of attendants with faces of fire—

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavo ghorās tridivavāsinaḥ parivārya mahāsenaṃ sthitā mātṛgaṇaiḥ saha
english: These and many other dreadful dwellers of the three heavens, together with the bands of mothers, surrounded Mahāsena and stood around him.

sanskrit: saṃdigdhaṃ vijayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vijayepsuḥ sureśvaraḥ āruhyairāvataskandhaṃ prayayau daivataiḥ saha vijighāṃsur mahāsenam indras tūrṇataraṃ yayau
english: Seeing victory as doubtful, the lord of the gods, eager for victory, mounted the shoulder of Airāvata and set out together with the divinities; Indra, desiring to slay Mahāsena, proceeded with all haste.

sanskrit: ugraṃ tac ca mahāvegaṃ devānīkaṃ mahāprabham vicitradhvajasaṃnāhaṃ nānāvāhanakārmukam pravarāmbarasaṃvītaṃ śriyā juṣṭam alaṃkṛtam
english: That fierce and swift divine army, radiant with great splendor, adorned with varied banners and armor, bearing many kinds of mounts and bows, clad in the finest garments, graced with beauty and ornaments—

sanskrit: vijighāṃsuṃ tadāyāntaṃ kumāraḥ śakram abhyayāt vinadan pathi śakras tu drutaṃ yāti mahābalaḥ saṃharṣayan devasenāṃ jighāṃsuḥ pāvakātmajam
english: The prince went forward to meet Śakra as he came eager to slay him, roaring on the way; and Śakra, of mighty strength, advanced swiftly, cheering the divine army, intent on slaying the son of Pāvaka.

sanskrit: saṃpūjyamānas tridaśais tathaiva paramarṣibhiḥ samīpam upasaṃprāptaḥ kārttikeyasya vāsavaḥ
english: Honored by the thirty gods and likewise by the great seers, Vāsava drew near to the presence of Kārttikeya.

sanskrit: siṃhanādaṃ tataś cakre deveśaḥ sahitaḥ suraiḥ guho 'pi śabdaṃ taṃ śrutvā vyanadat sāgaro yathā
english: Then the lord of the gods let out a lion's roar together with the gods; and Guha, hearing that sound, roared back like the ocean.

sanskrit: tasya śabdena mahatā samuddhūtodadhiprabham babhrāma tatra tatraiva devasainyam acetanam
english: By that great sound, resembling the surging of the sea, the divine army was thrown into confusion and reeled this way and that, senseless.

sanskrit: jighāṃsūn upasaṃprāptān devān dṛṣṭvā sa pāvakiḥ visasarja mukhāt kruddhaḥ pravṛddhāḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ tā devasainyāny adahan veṣṭamānāni bhūtale
english: Seeing the gods approach with intent to slay him, the son of Pāvaka, enraged, discharged from his mouth great blazing flames of fire; those flames burnt the divine armies as they writhed upon the ground.

sanskrit: te pradīptaśirodehāḥ pradīptāyudhavāhanāḥ pracyutāḥ sahasā bhānti citrās tārāgaṇā iva
english: They, with heads and bodies ablaze, with weapons and mounts on fire, fell suddenly and shone like a multitude of brilliant stars.

sanskrit: dahyamānāḥ prapannās te śaraṇaṃ pāvakātmajam devā vajradharaṃ tyaktvā tataḥ śāntim upāgatāḥ
english: Burning, those gods abandoned the wielder of the thunderbolt and sought the shelter of the son of Pāvaka; then they attained peace.

sanskrit: tyakto devais tataḥ skande vajraṃ śakro 'bhyavāsṛjat tad visṛṣṭaṃ jaghānāśu pārśvaṃ skandasya dakṣiṇam bibheda ca mahārāja pārśvaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ
english: Abandoned by the gods, Śakra then hurled his thunderbolt at Skanda; that bolt, once hurled, quickly struck Skanda's right side and pierced the side of that great soul, O great king.

sanskrit: vajraprahārāt skandasya saṃjātaḥ puruṣo 'paraḥ yuvā kāñcanasaṃnāhaḥ śaktidhṛg divyakuṇḍalaḥ yad vajraviśanāj jāto viśākhas tena so 'bhavat
english: From the thunderbolt's blow upon Skanda there arose another being—a young man clad in golden armor, bearing a lance, adorned with divine earrings; because he was born from the splitting by the thunderbolt, he became known as Viśākha.

sanskrit: taṃ jātam aparaṃ dṛṣṭvā kālānalasamadyutim bhayād indras tataḥ skandaṃ prāñjaliḥ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
english: Seeing this other being born, blazing like the fire of universal dissolution, Indra, out of fear, then went with joined palms to seek refuge with Skanda.

sanskrit: tasyābhayaṃ dadau skandaḥ sahasainyasya sattama tataḥ prahṛṣṭās tridaśā vāditrāṇy abhyavādayan
english: Skanda granted him safety together with his army, O noble one; then the thirty gods, filled with joy, sounded their musical instruments.

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca skandasya pārṣadān ghorāñ śṛṇuṣvādbhutadarśanān vajraprahārāt skandasya jajñus tatra kumārakāḥ ye haranti śiśūñ jātān garbhasthāṃś caiva dāruṇāḥ
english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: Hear of the dreadful attendants of Skanda, wondrous to behold—the boy-beings that were born there from the thunderbolt's blow upon Skanda, who are terrible and carry off newborn children and those still in the womb.

sanskrit: vajraprahārāt kanyāś ca jajñire 'sya mahābalāḥ kumārāś ca viśākhaṃ taṃ pitṛtve samakalpayan
english: Also from the thunderbolt's blow were born great-powerful maidens and boy-beings, and those boys acknowledged Viśākha in the role of father.

sanskrit: sa bhūtvā bhagavān saṃkhye rakṣaṃś chāgamukhas tadā vṛtaḥ kanyāgaṇaiḥ sarvair ātmanīnaiś ca putrakaiḥ
english: That blessed one, having become goat-faced in battle to protect them, was then surrounded by all the bands of maidens and his own boy-children.

sanskrit: mātṝṇāṃ prekṣatīnāṃ ca bhadraśākhaś ca kauśalaḥ tataḥ kumārapitaraṃ skandam āhur janā bhuvi
english: And with the mothers looking on, and Bhadraśākha displaying his skill, people on earth thereafter called Skanda the father of the Kumāras.

sanskrit: rudram agnim umāṃ svāhāṃ pradeśeṣu mahābalām yajanti putrakāmāś ca putriṇaś ca sadā janāḥ
english: People who desire sons and those who already have sons always worship Rudra, Agni, Umā, and mighty Svāhā in the various sacred places.

sanskrit: yās tās tv ajanayat kanyās tapo nāma hutāśanaḥ kiṃ karomīti tāḥ skandaṃ saṃprāptāḥ samabhāṣata
english: Now those maidens whom Agni the oblation-eater had generated as Tapas approached Skanda and spoke to him, saying, "What shall we do?"

sanskrit: mātara ūcuḥ bhavema sarvalokasya vayaṃ mātara uttamāḥ prasādāt tava pūjyāś ca priyam etat kuruṣva naḥ
english: The mothers said: Let us become the highest mothers of all the worlds and, by your grace, be worshipped as well. Grant us this boon that is dear to us.

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca so 'bravīd bāḍham ity evaṃ bhaviṣyadhvaṃ pṛthagvidhāḥ aśivāś ca śivāś caiva punaḥ punar udāradhīḥ
english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: He of noble mind said, "So be it," and declared, "You shall be of various kinds—both inauspicious and auspicious, again and again."

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃkalpya putratve skaṃdaṃ mātṛgaṇo 'gamat kākī ca halimā caiva rudrātha bṛhalī tathā āryā palālā vai mitrā saptaitāḥ śiśumātaraḥ
english: Then the band of mothers, having resolved to adopt Skanda as their son, approached him—Kākī and Halimā, and Rudra and Bṛhalī, and Āryā and Palālā and Mitra: these seven are the mothers of children.

sanskrit: etāsāṃ vīryasaṃpannaḥ śiśur nāmātidāruṇaḥ skandaprasādajaḥ putro lohitākṣo bhayaṃkaraḥ
english: Of these mothers there is a child endowed with prowess, named Śiśu, exceedingly terrible, born by Skanda's grace—the red-eyed, fearsome son.

sanskrit: eṣa vīrāṣṭakaḥ proktaḥ skandamātṛgaṇodbhavaḥ chāgavaktreṇa sahito navakaḥ parikīrtyate
english: This group of eight heroes, born of Skanda's band of mothers, together with the goat-faced one, is proclaimed a group of nine.

sanskrit: ṣaṣṭhaṃ chāgamayaṃ vaktraṃ skandasyaiveti viddhi tat ṣaṭśiro 'bhyantaraṃ rājan nityaṃ mātṛgaṇārcitam
english: Know that the sixth, the goat-shaped face, belongs to Skanda himself; the innermost of the six heads, O king, is always worshipped by the band of mothers.

sanskrit: ṣaṇṇāṃ tu pravaraṃ tasya śīrṣāṇām iha śabdyate śaktiṃ yenāsṛjad divyāṃ bhadraśākha iti sma ha
english: The chief among his six heads is here designated as the one with which he created the divine lance—this is called Bhadraśākha.

sanskrit: ity etad vividhākāraṃ vṛttaṃ śuklasya pañcamīm tatra yuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ vṛttaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ janādhipa
english: Thus all this multiform event occurred on the fifth day of the bright fortnight; and that great and terrible battle took place on the sixth, O lord of men.

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca upaviṣṭaṃ tataḥ skandaṃ hiraṇyakavacasrajam hiraṇyacūḍamukuṭaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahāprabham
english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: Then Skanda was seen seated, wearing a golden armor and garland, with a golden crest and crown, golden-eyed, and of great radiance—

sanskrit: lohitāmbarasaṃvītaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ manoramam sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ trailokyasyāpi supriyam
english: Clad in red garments, with sharp fangs, enchanting to behold, endowed with all auspicious marks, and deeply beloved even by the three worlds.

sanskrit: tatas taṃ varadaṃ śūraṃ yuvānaṃ mṛṣṭakuṇḍalam abhajat padmarūpā śrīḥ svayam eva śarīriṇī
english: Then Śrī, of lotus form and herself embodied, chose of her own accord that boon-giving, heroic youth with polished earrings.

sanskrit: śriyā juṣṭaḥ pṛthuyaśāḥ sa kumāravaras tadā niṣaṇṇo dṛśyate bhūtaiḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī
english: Graced by Śrī and of wide renown, that foremost prince, as he sat, was seen by all beings like the moon on a full-moon night.

sanskrit: apūjayan mahātmāno brāhmaṇās taṃ mahābalam idam āhus tadā caiva skandaṃ tatra maharṣayaḥ
english: The great-souled brahmins honored that mighty one, and the great seers then spoke these words to Skanda there:

sanskrit: hiraṇyavarṇa bhadraṃ te lokānāṃ śaṃkaro bhava tvayā ṣaḍrātrajātena sarve lokā vaśīkṛtāḥ
english: "O golden-hued one, blessings be upon you—be the benefactor of the worlds! By you, born within six nights, all the worlds have been brought under sway.

sanskrit: abhayaṃ ca punar dattaṃ tvayaivaiṣāṃ surottama tasmād indro bhavān astu trailokyasyābhayaṃkaraḥ
english: And safety has been granted to them again by you alone, O best of gods; therefore let you be Indra, the giver of safety to the three worlds."

sanskrit: skanda uvāca kim indraḥ sarvalokānāṃ karotīha tapodhanāḥ kathaṃ devagaṇāṃś caiva pāti nityaṃ sureśvaraḥ
english: Skanda said: What does Indra do for all the worlds here, O those rich in austerity? How does the lord of the gods always protect the hosts of divinities?

sanskrit: ṛṣaya ūcuḥ indro diśati bhūtānāṃ balaṃ tejaḥ prajāḥ sukham tuṣṭaḥ prayacchati tathā sarvān dāyān sureśvaraḥ
english: The sages said: Indra bestows strength, energy, offspring, and happiness upon all beings; when pleased, the lord of the gods grants all boons likewise.

sanskrit: durvṛttānāṃ saṃharati vṛttasthānāṃ prayacchati anuśāsti ca bhūtāni kāryeṣu balasūdanaḥ
english: He destroys the wicked and sustains the righteous; the slayer of Bala guides all beings in their duties.

sanskrit: asūrye ca bhavet sūryas tathācandre ca candramāḥ bhavaty agniś ca vāyuś ca pṛthivy āpaś ca kāraṇaiḥ
english: When the sun is absent he becomes the sun, and so too the moon when the moon is absent; fire and wind, earth and water—all these arise through his agency.

sanskrit: etad indreṇa kartavyam indre hi vipulaṃ balam tvaṃ ca vīra balaśreṣṭhas tasmād indro bhavasva naḥ
english: This is what Indra must do, for in Indra resides vast power; and you too, O hero, are supreme in strength—therefore become Indra for us.

sanskrit: śakra uvāca bhavasvendro mahābāho sarveṣāṃ naḥ sukhāvahaḥ abhiṣicyasva caivādya prāptarūpo 'si sattama
english: Śakra said: Become Indra, O mighty-armed one—the bringer of happiness to all of us. Be consecrated this very day; you have attained the fitting form, O noble one.

sanskrit: skanda uvāca śādhi tvam eva trailokyam avyagro vijaye rataḥ ahaṃ te kiṃkaraḥ śakra na mamendratvam īpsitam
english: Skanda said: You yourself govern the three worlds without confusion, devoted to victory; I am your servant, O Śakra—I do not desire lordship over Indra's realm.

sanskrit: śakra uvāca balaṃ tavādbhutaṃ vīra tvaṃ devānām arīñ jahi avajñāsyanti māṃ lokā vīryeṇa tava vismitāḥ
english: Śakra said: Your strength is wondrous, O hero; slay the enemies of the gods. The worlds will disrespect me, astonished by your might.

sanskrit: indratve 'pi sthitaṃ vīra balahīnaṃ parājitam āvayoś ca mitho bhede prayatiṣyanty atandritāḥ
english: Even though I remain in the position of Indra, I have been shown powerless and defeated, O hero; and the diligent ones will strive to create a split between the two of us.

sanskrit: bhedite ca tvayi vibho loko dvaidham upeṣyati dvidhābhūteṣu lokeṣu niściteṣv āvayos tathā vigrahaḥ saṃpravarteta bhūtabhedān mahābala
english: And when you are estranged from me, O lord, the world will split in two; when the worlds are divided in two and our rift is assured, conflict between beings will ensue, O mighty one.

sanskrit: tatra tvaṃ māṃ raṇe tāta yathāśraddhaṃ vijeṣyasi tasmād indro bhavān adya bhavitā mā vicāraya
english: There in battle you will defeat me at will, dear friend; therefore let you be Indra this very day—do not deliberate.

sanskrit: skanda uvāca tvam eva rājā bhadraṃ te trailokyasya mamaiva ca karomi kiṃ ca te śakra śāsanaṃ tad bravīhi me
english: Skanda said: You alone are king—blessings to you—of the three worlds and of me as well; what command of yours, O Śakra, shall I carry out? Tell it to me.

sanskrit: śakra uvāca yadi satyam idaṃ vākyaṃ niścayād bhāṣitaṃ tvayā yadi vā śāsanaṃ skanda kartum icchasi me śṛṇu
english: Śakra said: If this word is truly spoken by you with full conviction, or if you wish to carry out my command, O Skanda, then listen.

sanskrit: abhiṣicyasva devānāṃ senāpatye mahābala aham indro bhaviṣyāmi tava vākyān mahābala
english: Be consecrated as commander-in-chief of the gods, O mighty one; I shall be Indra by your word, O mighty one.

sanskrit: skanda uvāca dānavānāṃ vināśāya devānām arthasiddhaye gobrāhmaṇasya trāṇārthaṃ senāpatye 'bhiṣiñca mām
english: Skanda said: For the destruction of the Dānavas, for the accomplishment of the gods' purposes, for the protection of cattle and brahmins—consecrate me as commander-in-chief.

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca so 'bhiṣikto maghavatā sarvair devagaṇaiḥ saha atīva śuśubhe tatra pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ
english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: Consecrated by Maghavat together with all the hosts of gods, he shone there exceedingly, honored by the great seers.

sanskrit: tasya tat kāñcanaṃ chatraṃ dhriyamāṇaṃ vyarocata yathaiva susamiddhasya pāvakasyātmamaṇḍalam
english: His golden parasol, as it was held aloft, shone like the self-luminous halo of a well-kindled fire.

sanskrit: viśvakarmakṛtā cāsya divyā mālā hiraṇmayī ābaddhā tripuraghnena svayam eva yaśasvinā
english: And his divine golden garland, fashioned by Viśvakarman, was fastened upon him by the glorious slayer of Tripura himself.

sanskrit: āgamya manujavyāghra saha devyā paraṃtapa arcayām āsa suprīto bhagavān govṛṣadhvajaḥ
english: Coming there together with the Goddess, O scorcher of foes, O tiger among men, the blessed lord whose banner bears a bull worshipped him with great delight.

sanskrit: rudram agniṃ dvijāḥ prāhū rudrasūnus tatas tu saḥ rudreṇa śukram utsṛṣṭaṃ tac chvetaḥ parvato 'bhavat pāvakasyendriyaṃ śvete kṛttikābhiḥ kṛtaṃ nage
english: The twice-born call him son of Rudra and of Agni; and he became son of Rudra thereafter. The semen released by Rudra became the White Mountain, and the seed of Agni was received on that white peak by the Kṛttikās.

sanskrit: pūjyamānaṃ tu rudreṇa dṛṣṭvā sarve divaukasaḥ rudrasūnuṃ tataḥ prāhur guhaṃ guṇavatāṃ varam
english: Seeing him honored by Rudra, all the celestials then called him son of Rudra—Guha, the best among the virtuous.

sanskrit: anupraviśya rudreṇa vahniṃ jāto hy ayaṃ śiśuḥ tatra jātas tataḥ skando rudrasūnus tato 'bhavat
english: For Rudra, having entered into Agni, this child was born; born there, Skanda then became the son of Rudra.

sanskrit: rudrasya vahneḥ svāhāyāḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca tejasā jātaḥ skandaḥ suraśreṣṭho rudrasūnus tato 'bhavat
english: Born of the energy of Rudra, of Agni, of Svāhā, and of the six women, Skanda—best of the gods—thereafter became known as son of Rudra.

sanskrit: araje vāsasī rakte vasānaḥ pāvakātmajaḥ bhāti dīptavapuḥ śrīmān raktābhrābhyām ivāṃśumān
english: The son of Pāvaka, wearing two red spotless garments, blazes with a luminous body, glorious, like the sun amid red clouds.

sanskrit: kukkuṭaś cāgninā dattas tasya ketur alaṃkṛtaḥ rathe samucchrito bhāti kālāgnir iva lohitaḥ
english: The rooster given to him by Agni, adorned as his banner standard and raised aloft on his chariot, shines red like the fire of dissolution.

sanskrit: viveśa kavacaṃ cāsya śarīraṃ sahajaṃ tataḥ yudhyamānasya devasya prādurbhavati tat sadā
english: Then his innate bodily armor entered him; it always manifests for that divine one when he fights.

sanskrit: śaktir varma balaṃ tejaḥ kāntatvaṃ satyam akṣatiḥ brahmaṇyatvam asaṃmoho bhaktānāṃ parirakṣaṇam
english: Power, armor, strength, energy, beauty, truth, inviolability, devotion to the brahmins, freedom from delusion, protection of devotees—

sanskrit: nikṛntanaṃ ca śatrūṇāṃ lokānāṃ cābhirakṣaṇam skandena saha jātāni sarvāṇy eva janādhipa
english: The destruction of enemies and the protection of the worlds—all these were born together with Skanda, O lord of men.

sanskrit: evaṃ devagaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ so 'bhiṣiktaḥ svalaṃkṛtaḥ babhau pratītaḥ sumanāḥ paripūrṇendudarśanaḥ
english: Thus consecrated by all the hosts of gods and splendidly adorned, he shone forth, radiant and pleased, like the sight of the full moon.

sanskrit: iṣṭaiḥ svādhyāyaghoṣaiś ca devatūryaravair api devagandharvagītaiś ca sarvair apsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ
english: With beloved sounds of sacred recitation, with the noise of divine instruments, with songs of the divine Gandharvas, and with all the hosts of Apsarases—

sanskrit: etaiś cānyaiś ca vividhair hṛṣṭatuṣṭair alaṃkṛtaiḥ krīḍann iva tadā devair abhiṣiktaḥ sa pāvakiḥ
english: With these and many other varied joyful and satisfied adorned beings, the son of Pāvaka was consecrated then, as if at play with the gods.

sanskrit: abhiṣiktaṃ mahāsenam apaśyanta divaukasaḥ vinihatya tamaḥ sūryaṃ yathehābhyuditaṃ tathā
english: The celestials beheld Mahāsena consecrated, like the sun here that dispels darkness and rises.

sanskrit: athainam abhyayuḥ sarvā devasenāḥ sahasraśaḥ asmākaṃ tvaṃ patir iti bruvāṇāḥ sarvatodiśam
english: Then all the divine armies, by the thousands, approached him from every direction, saying, "You are our lord."

sanskrit: tāḥ samāsādya bhagavān sarvabhūtagaṇair vṛtaḥ arcitaś ca stutaś caiva sāntvayām āsa tā api
english: Meeting them, the blessed one, surrounded by all the hosts of beings, and himself honored and praised, soothed them as well.

sanskrit: śatakratuś cābhiṣicya skandaṃ senāpatiṃ tadā sasmāra tāṃ devasenāṃ yā sā tena vimokṣitā
english: And Śatakratu, having consecrated Skanda as commander-in-chief, then remembered that divine army of women who had been liberated by him.

sanskrit: ayaṃ tasyāḥ patir nūnaṃ vihito brahmaṇā svayam iti cintyānayām āsa devasenāṃ svalaṃkṛtām
english: Thinking, "This one is surely ordained as her lord by Brahmā himself," he brought the beautifully adorned Devasenā.

sanskrit: skandaṃ covāca balabhid iyaṃ kanyā surottama ajāte tvayi nirdiṣṭā tava patnī svayaṃbhuvā
english: And he said to Skanda: "This maiden, O best of gods, was appointed as your wife by the Self-born one before you were born.

sanskrit: tasmāt tvam asyā vidhivat pāṇiṃ mantrapuraskṛtam gṛhāṇa dakṣiṇaṃ devyāḥ pāṇinā padmavarcasam
english: Therefore take properly, according to ritual, accompanied by sacred formulas, the right hand of this goddess whose radiance is like a lotus—take it with your hand."

sanskrit: evam uktaḥ sa jagrāha tasyāḥ pāṇiṃ yathāvidhi bṛhaspatir mantravidhiṃ jajāpa ca juhāva ca
english: Thus instructed, he took her hand duly according to rule; and Bṛhaspati recited the ritual formulas and performed the fire oblations.

sanskrit: evaṃ skandasya mahiṣīṃ devasenāṃ vidur budhāḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ yāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ prāhur lakṣmīm āśāṃ sukhapradām sinīvālīṃ kuhūṃ caiva sadvṛttim aparājitām
english: Thus the wise know Devasenā as the chief queen of Skanda—she whom the brahmins call the Sixth, Lakṣmī, hope, the bestower of happiness, Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Sadvṛtti, and Aparājitā.

sanskrit: yadā skandaḥ patir labdhaḥ śāśvato devasenayā tadā tam āśrayal lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ devī śarīriṇī
english: When Devasenā obtained Skanda as her eternal lord, then the goddess Lakṣmī herself, embodied, took refuge in him.

sanskrit: śrījuṣṭaḥ pañcamīṃ skandas tasmāc chrīpañcamī smṛtā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛtārtho 'bhūd yasmāt tasmāt ṣaṣṭhī mahātithiḥ
english: Because Skanda was graced by Śrī on the fifth, that fifth day is remembered as Śrī-pañcamī; because he attained his purpose on the sixth, the sixth is a great sacred day.

sanskrit: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca śriyā juṣṭaṃ mahāsenaṃ devasenāpatiṃ kṛtam saptarṣipatnyaḥ ṣaḍ devyas tatsakāśam athāgaman
english: Mārkaṇḍeya said: When Mahāsena, graced by Śrī, had been made commander of the divine army, the six goddesses who were wives of the Seven Sages then came to his presence.
